title: Kissed with Spice Tunisian Chicken Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic North African-inspired dish featuring chicken, palm sugar, and a blend of spices, all cooked to perfection in a clay tagine.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the cumin seeds and coriander seeds to the oil and cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant and toasted, about 2 minutes.
Add the sliced ginger and cook, stirring occasionally, for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the chicken to the tagine and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned on all sides and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the palm sugar, bhuna curry powder, salt, and pepper to the tagine and stir to combine.
Cover the tagine and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 10-15 minutes or until the sauce has thickened and the chicken is cooked through.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
Serve hot over couscous or rice.
